{{Quote|So what if I ''did'' embellish a bit? I was only attempting to make you sound more civilized.|M-TD to Lowbacca|<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Heirs of the Force">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Heirs of the Force]]''</ref>}}
'''M-TD''', short for "miniaturized [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droid]]" and nicknamed '''Em Teedee''', was a specialized translator droid used by [[Lowbacca]] while attending [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]]. Like almost all [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], "Lowie" was physically unable to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]], and so M-TD was programmed to translate his [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] to a form his friends would understand. 

The droid was built by Lowbacca's uncle [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and programmed by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] after Chewbacca learned that his nephew planned on attending the Jedi Academy.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ah, See-Threepio! My counterpart, my predecessor, my...''mentor''!|M-TD, to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="TLO">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]''</ref>}}
[[File:MTD_egtd.png|thumb|left|200px|Em Teedee [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]].]]
M-TD was presented to [[Lowbacca]] by his uncle [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] when the young [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] arrived at the [[Jedi Praxeum]]. Anyone who had spent a significant time with [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was struck by the uncanny resemblance of M-TD's personality to that of his programmer. M-TD annoyed Lowbacca and his friends to no end because of his tendency to embellish his translations of Lowbacca's statements. He reasoned that his translations were more refined and would make Lowbacca sound more civilized.<ref name="HotF" />

Lowbacca himself would cause M-TD much distress by not affixing the little droid securely enough to his [[Syren plant/Legends|syren fiber]] belt and accidentally letting him fall. On one of the first such occasions, the young Wookiee was ripping through the [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4's]] jungle at a fast pace, trying to get word to the Praxeum that [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and Jaina had been kidnapped by [[Qorl]], a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[TIE pilot|pilot]] who had been living in the jungle since the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. M-TD came to a soft landing without hitting the ground, but he was claimed as a prize by a [[Woolamander/Legends|woolamander]]. Fortunately for M-TD, he was found by a wayward [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], who then used his navigational capabilities to return to the Praxeum and by extension, return him to his owner.<ref name="HotF" />

===Second Imperium Crisis===
{{Quote|Master Lowbacca, would you mind turning around so that I can see the entire room? If this is my birthplace, I'd like to give it a good look&hellip; How fascinating!|M-TD, on Kashyyyk|<ref name="DK">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Darkest Knight]]</ref>}}
[[File:MTDtop-FF83.png|thumb|right|250px|A view of Em Teedee from the top back.]]
M-TD was later kidnapped by the [[Shadow Academy]] along with Lowbacca and the [[Solo twins]] during the [[Raid on GemDiver Station|raid]] on [[GemDiver Station]]. He was immediately taken away from Lowbacca which caused a great deal of confusion between the young Wookiee and his Human friends. After Lowbacca gave into his anger, smashing a [[Sonic generator/Legends|sonic generator]] beyond repair, M-TD was given back to him as a reward by [[Tamith Kai]].<ref name="SA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shadow Academy]]''</ref>

However, something was definitely wrong with M-TD: He had become uncharacteristically defiant of Lowbacca; He would reproach Lowbacca whenever he broke the rules of the Shadow Academy; And most worryingly, he would spout phrases such as "The [[Second Imperium|Empire]] is your friend" and other pro-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] propaganda. As he had been happy to inform Lowbacca, M-TD had been reprogrammed by [[Brakiss]] and Tamith Kai to become an "integral part" of Lowbacca's instruction at the Shadow Academy.<ref name="SA" />

[[File:MTDback-FF83.png|thumb|left|250px|A view of the back of Em Teedee]]
Due to several threats made by Jacen, Jaina, and Lowbacca, M-TD helped them escape from their prison, though. While he warned the trio that he felt he had the responsibility to sound an alarm, M-TD's programming didn't hinder him from slicing into the Shadow Academy's computers to obtain passwords that would seal all of the Shadow Academy's doors and turn off its [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]]. This was followed by an alarm. When they were finally rescued, M-TD's old programming was restored and he was back to his old annoying self, but he remained "exceedingly vexed" toward Brakiss and Tamith Kai for causing him to violate his primary programming.<ref name="SA" />

Sometime thereafter, M-TD accompanied Lowbacca and his friends on their vacation to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Upon reaching the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] he was elated to find his programmer, C-3PO, was there to greet them. The two droids would tell each other of the harrowing experiences that had occurred to them since they had last seen each other.<ref name="TLO" />

Lowbacca's vacation&mdash;and by extension M-TD's&mdash;would be cut short with the discovery that the cloaked Shadow Academy had been orbiting Coruscant while abducting [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] youths and causing havoc for the traffic that had been flowing in and out of Coruscant. M-TD and the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] also had an altercation with the street gang known as the [[Lost Ones]], which ended largely due to the intervention of a mother [[Hawk-bat/Legends|hawk-bat]] that [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] had [[Animal bond|bonded]] with.<ref name="TLO" /> 

Shortly afterwards, M-TD witnessed the creation of Lowbacca's [[Lowbacca's lightsaber|personal]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. They would later accompany the Solo twins to visit Tenel Ka Djo on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], where he proved useful in translating for the [[Mairan/Legends|Mairan]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] and narrowly escaped a [[carnivorous seaweed]] as well as an [[Raid on Reef Fortress|assassination attempt]] on Tenel Ka's grandmother, [[Queen Mother]] [[Ta'a Chume]].<ref name="Lightsabers">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]''</ref> In another such adventure on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], T-MD began to wonder if the [[Thikkiiana computer fabrication facility]] was where many of his parts were gathered from. He and the tour droid at the computer center had a brief argument on etiquette.<ref name="DK" />

T-MD found himself in the middle of a warzone when the Second Imperium [[Third Battle of Yavin|attacked]] the Jedi Praxeum. When Lowbacca's [[T-23 skyhopper]] was shot down by a TIE fighter, causing him, M-TD and Tenel Ka to crash-land in the trees, the translator droid feared the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] had perished; that was fortunately not the case. He could only watch and fret as Lowbacca fought off Tamith Kai's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and Tenel Ka took the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] down in explosive fashion. Not only were Tenel Ka and Lowbacca injured while jumping away, but M-TD needed his [[Speaker/Legends|speaker]] grille straightened out.<ref name="JUS">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Under Siege]]''</ref>

===The Graveyard===
{{Quote|I feel so&hellip; ''useful'' here in my position. Almost like the captain of a ship."''<br/>''"Don't get delusions of granduer, Em Teedee.|M-TD and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], aboard the ''Rock Dragon''|<ref name="SoA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shards of Alderaan]]''</ref>}}
M-TD accompanied the four Padawans to [[the Graveyard]] on Tenel Ka's ship, the ''[[Rock Dragon]]'', in search of a birthday present for the Solo twins' mother, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. However, they were ambushed seemingly by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] (in reality his daughter [[Ailyn Vel]]). Not only did M-TD run diagnostics on the ''Rock Dragon'' for "shortcuts" passed the damaged systems, but upon Jacen's suggestion, he remotely sliced into the ''[[Slave IV]]''{{'}}s [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]], gaining precious date on the bounty placed on [[Bornan Thul]] by the mysterious [[Nolaa Tarkona]]. However, he didn't cover his tracks thoroughly, prompting Vel to try and permanently silence the group. It only took the timely arrival of [[Zekk]]'s ''[[Lightning Rod]]'' to drive Vel away, and a delayed message M-TD sent via the ''Rock Dragon''{{'}}s weakened [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] dish brought the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' to take the [[Hapan]] ship back to Yavin 4.<ref name="SoA" /> 

===Diversity Alliance===
{{Quote|Oh my! We could be doomed! But I ''would'' gladly sacrifice my last circuit if it would be of any help to Master Lowbacca. Indeed&hellip; going to Ryloth may be an excellent opportunity for me to use my translating skills; I ''am'' fluent in over sixteen forms of communication, you know. Well, I suppose that's all settled, then.|M-TD|<ref name="JB">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Bounty]]''</ref>}}
When all four Padawans decided to stay aboard the ''[[Tradewyn]]'' to visit the family of their friend, [[Raynar Thul]], M-TD was delighted to be amongst "civilization". He did not, however, take a great liking to Raynar's uncle [[Tyko Thul|Tyko]], who did not value droids very highly. After an attack by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] ship ''[[High Roller]]'', M-TD was allowed access into the ''Tradewyn''{{'}}s bridge computer, where he discovered that bridge officer [[Kusk]] had set up the ambush on the ship in order to capture Raynar or his mother, [[Aryn Dro Thul]], and escape with his brother aboard the ''High Roller''. The Padawans proceeded to search for Raynar's [[Bornan Thul|missing father]] on the planet [[Kuar]]. Once there, they narrowly escaped a horde of [[Combat arachnid/Legends|combat arichnids]] and met Lowbacca's old friend [[Raabakyysh]]. Tyko later joined in the search but was kidnapped by the infamous [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]], whose reemergence intrigued M-TD.<ref name="DA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Diversity Alliance]]''</ref>

M-TD felt distraught to be left alone by Lowbacca when the Wookiee returned to Kashyyyk with Raaba. Apprehension crept into his circuits upon hearing the nature of the [[Diversity Alliance]], the anti-[[Human/Legends|human]] organization that Raaba had joined. M-TD travelled with Jacen, Jaina, Tenel Ka and Raynar to the factory world of [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]]. There, they learned that Tyko Thul had not only faked his own abduction but also reprogrammed IG-88A to serve him. Once M-TD aided in repairing the weapons systems that the Padawans had destroyed, Tyko praised the little droid, causing them to reconcile, and allowed him to take whatever upgrades he desired. While testing his [[micro repulsorlift]]s, he alerted the others to the arrival of their friend [[Zekk]].<ref name="DoG">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Delusions of Grandeur]]''</ref>

M-TD was damaged when a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt from the bounty hunter [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] glanced off IG-88A and hit him. As soon as he was repaired, he hooked up to IG-88A's memory core and downloaded everything he could on Bornan Thul. While returning to Yavin 4, his worry increased when Lowbacca's parents informed the Padawans of Lowbacca and his sister [[Sirrakuk]]'s seemingly joining the Diversity Alliance.<ref name="DoG" />

Weeks later, M-TD eagerly joined the Solo twins, Raynar and Tenel Ka to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] so as to rescue Lowbacca and Sirrakuk. He aided Jaina in [[Magnetic clamp/Legends|clamping]] the ''Rock Dragon'' onto an [[ore hauler]], infiltrating the Diversity Alliance base with ease and hiding when troops inspected the ship. However, they were soon caught, and M-TD was stored away with the Tenal Ka and the twins' [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. Lowbacca then broke the translator droid out and executed a plan for rescuing his friends, then convinced Sirrakuk of the true intentions of the Diversity Alliance. M-TD was swatted away by the claw of [[Corrsk (Diversity Alliance)|Corrsk]] but suffered no damage by the time the Wookiees flew the ''Rock Dragon'' away from the base.<ref name="JB" />

M-TD, the Padawans, Zekk and the resurfaced Bornan Thul raced to an [[Emperor's plague storehouse|abandoned weapons depot]] housing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bioweapons, [[Emperor's Plague|one]] in particular proving deadly to [[Human/Legends|humans]]. He proved instrumental in opening the door that led to the central chamber, where all the deadly viruses were stored. But before they could destroy the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], they had to [[Battle of the Emperor's Plague Storehouse|contend]] with the Diversity Alliance. M-TD was nearly sucked out of an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] when Lowbacca opened it to eliminate Corrsk. They bumped into IG-88A, who assisted in breaking any doors that stood in their way to the central chamber. A week after the destruction of the storehouse, M-TD provided several translations for former Diversity Alliance members who traveled to Coruscant to give their accounts, and he enjoyed himself in the celebration of the rebuilt [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on Yavin 4.<ref name="TEP">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Emperor's Plague]]''</ref>

===Black Sun===
M-TD found himself in the ''Rock Dragon'' as Zekk, Lowbacca and Tenel Ka used it to win the [[Blockade Runners Derby]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]; he had been hoping by this point to avoid any further "emergencies". Unfortunately, the translator droid was mixed up in an attack by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] as well as a terrible civil war on [[Anobis]]. While there, he helped distract one of the [[Knaar]]s attacking the [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]], which allowed Lowbacca to slay the beast.<ref name="RTOM">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Return to Ord Mantell]]''</ref> 
{{Expandsect}}

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
M-TD accompanied Lowbacca on the [[Mission to Myrkr|mission]] to [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. Lowbacca detached M-TD and left him aboard the ''[[Tachyon Flier]]''. He was aboard the ship along with a barely conscious Raynar Thul when the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Lomi Plo]] and [[Welk]] stole it. The last that the strike team heard of him was his complaint that he was being stolen. M-TD was destroyed after the ''Tachyon Flier'' crashed on the planet [[Yoggoy]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. His remains were discovered by Jacen Solo in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], although he could barely recognize it, the little droid being melted and fused to the floor.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Ah, Em Teedee, how kind of you to lend, um&hellip; to lend a wire. You are the one droid in the galaxy I truly trust&mdash;with the exception of my own IG-88, of course."''<br/>''"Why, thank you, Master Tyko. I do try.|Tyko Thul and M-TD|<ref name="DoG" />}}
[[File:Lowbacca18.jpg|thumb|150px|M-TD attached to [[Lowbacca]]'s belt.]]
Capable of speaking six different languages after he was programmed, M-TD specialized in Human-Wookiee relations. M-TD's yellow [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] could provide illumination to compensate for varying degrees of lighting. He also featured olfactory, directional and auditory sensors.<ref name="HotF" /> Since Lowbacca was going to spend a large amount of time on Yavin 4, Chewbacca also installed a limited database of the jungle moon's geography and wildlife in M-TD's memory banks.

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Why it feels absolutely&hellip; ''ops'nyzh''! That is an expression tha means 'approaching euphoric' in the Bothan language. Oh&mdash;I didn't ''know'' that word before. I know I am fluent in over sixteen forms of communication!|M-TD, after his upgrades|<ref name="DoG" />}}
A system of micro repulsorlifts was installed on M-TD during his time on Mechis III. Additionally, Jaina had him waterproofed, and his language database was increased by ten, bringing the total number of languages to sixteen that M-TD could translate.<ref name="DoG" />

In contrast, C-3PO is able to speak more than six million languages.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Throughout the [[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights|''Young Jedi Knights'']] series, where he first appeared, his name was always spelled "Em Teedee." The "M-TD" spelling was introduced into canon later.

In the video game ''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'', M-TD is used as a symbol for the [[motivation actuator]].
